# logonui.exe is all Rust (logonui-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/logonui-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# logonui.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/logonui-rust/src/logonui/logonui.rs)
# NT5design.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/logonui-rust/src/logonui/NT5design.rs)
add_cargo_module(logonui logonui-cargo logonui.exe
    KIND win32exe
    BODY_CRATE logonui-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS psdk)
